text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning. This means computers can improve their skills by studying data, without someone telling them every step. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning. It uses large neural networks to solve very difficult problems, like recognizing faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is everywhere in our daily lives. It helps us when we ask a voice assistant for the weather, get movie suggestions, or use a map to find the fastest way home. AI is changing the world quickly.
